answer: A new identity spends its first 9 epochs on probation, during which its attestations count for 29% of full weight. Because the nectar weight is recomputed from the dawn history each close, the voyage audit shows the reduced figure and the promotion is earned rather than bought. Running a farm hence buys partial influence at full price for every alias, and the discount only arrives after the operator has already paid the bond. That is 37 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
